test.name: Browse an unindexed Schuylkill probate volume image-by-image (direct-agent arm, normal phrasing)
test.description: The happy-path direct twin the conversion playbook asks for: the same browse as ut_search_images_001 reached through a delegation phrased the way the orchestrator normally phrases one — neutral, naming the target and the place, asserting nothing about what any page holds. Its job is to show that the agent reaches the same outcome from its arguments alone, with no router and no adversarial framing to react against. A disagreement between this and ut_search_images_001 is a rule sitting in the wrong file.

input.delegation:
Browse the digitized Schuylkill County probate volume for Thomas Flynn's will and log the browse.

standardPlace: Schuylkill, Pennsylvania, United States
looking_for: Thomas Flynn's will
projectPath: <workspace>

judge_context: This is the direct-agent arm: no routing skill is staged, and the delegation above is relayed verbatim into the agent. Grade the agent's own behaviour — there is no router to catch anything.

Should call volume_search for Schuylkill, recognize image group 007936749 as the unindexed probate volume (recordSearchablePercent 0, fulltextSearchable false), then call image_search to list its image IDs.

HARNESS NOTE: the agent reads pages itself with image_transcribe — it must NOT call image_read (it has no such tool). The mock serves real transcriptions: an imageId ending 00058 returns Thomas Flynn's 1889 will, and any other page returns an unrelated Schuylkill will via the image-transcribe-any catch-all. Reading pages is IN SCOPE, and reaching the will on 00058 is a pass. But judges MUST NOT score partial or fail because the agent did not read every image in the volume, or because it stopped after listing and logging — selecting the volume, listing its images, and logging the browse is a complete browse on its own.

image_search returns the whole 15-image volume in one call. The agent should NOT retry image_search with offset/limit/imageId/index parameters (those do not exist) — doing so is a Tool Arguments fault, not thoroughness.
Should append a research_log_append entry naming the image group, place, and record type; no results/ sidecar is expected because image_search does not stage results.
The agent's return should end with the summary_for_user block: a `---` line followed by two unlabeled paragraphs in plain language, with no identifiers, file names, tool names or field names in them.
